‘secondary knowledge’, N. of a class of writings subordinate or appended to the four Vedas (viz. the आयुर्-वेद, or science of medicine, to the Ṛg-veda; the धनुर्वेद or science of archery, to the Yajur-veda; the गान्धर्व-वेद or science of music, to the Sāmaveda; and the शस्त्र-शास्त्र or science of arms, to the Atharva-veda; this is according to the Caraṇavyūha, but, Suśr. and the Bhpr. make the Āyur-veda belong to the Atharva-veda; according to others, the स्थापत्य-वेद or science of architecture, and शिल्प-शास्त्र or knowledge of arts, are reckoned as the fourth Upa-veda).
